verdict.summary: Cacao powder is generally safe for individuals with coeliac disease as it is derived from cacao beans, which are naturally gluten-free. However, cross-contamination during processing can pose a risk if not handled properly.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.
